title: Đề thi thử VSTEP — Review ĐH Ngoại ngữ Huế 23/8/2026 (Viết + Nói)

questions.content:
writing — Task 1

You recently spent a few days at a hotel while you were on holiday. Although you enjoyed the food very much, you were unhappy with the attitude of some of the staff. Write a letter to the hotel manager. In your letter, you should: 1. describe your stay and explain what you liked and what disappointed you 2. ask the manager for an apology and a refund 3. suggest how the hotel could improve its service

writing — Task 2

You should spend about 60 minutes on this task. Many people enjoy sharing their memories, such as photos and videos of special moments, on social media. Some people believe that doing this is a good thing, while others think it is not a good idea. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write an essay of at least 250 words.

speaking — Part 1

In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about advertising, and then about your biggest achievement.

speaking — Part 2

Situation: You want to improve your English, and you are thinking about the best way to make real progress. You are considering the following ways: 1. Joining an English speaking club 2. Making friends with foreigners 3. Studying abroad in an English-speaking country Which way do you think is the best? Why?
